name: OreVein - Advanced Vein Mining
description: Vein mining that actually feels like Minecraft! Hold sneak to mine entire ore veins, trees & common blocks at vanilla speeds. Supports all ores (iron, diamond, ancient debris, etc), logs, leaves, storage blocks, plus stone/cobble/netherrack/basalt for lazy miners. Nano Tunneling unlocks at 500 XP - toggle 1x2/3x3/5x5 modes with netherite pick. Respects Efficiency, Unbreaking, tool durability & Haste. Extra inventory row unlocks at 10000 XP.
